scenario.cadence_assumption: UC overdue assessments preserve hourly strength; energy rates, hourly rates and already specified per-period amounts unchanged
scenario.episode_boundary: complete month from day one; terminal valuation once at month end
scenario.initial_state: month start; empty queues; zero monthly UC energy; configured initial ESS

scenario_prices.all_monetary_coefficients: AUD scenario values, not observed tariffs

protocol.initialization: fresh paired encoder/head per seed; time extra input weights zero; GRU new
protocol.recurrent_inputs: same 68 current UC observation fields; no extra actions, rewards or private data
protocol.prefix: replay from real month start at current weights before each minibatch, no prefix loss/gradient
protocol.sampling: one frozen stochastic joint-policy trajectory per month
protocol.evaluation: final epoch fixed in advance; no early stopping or validation-based model selection

scope: Conditional on one frozen joint policy and one stochastic path per month; seed SD measures optimization variability, not policy/environment generalization uncertainty.
